messages:
Alex: Quick idea — propose a 'remediation ledger' + compact timeline template to close postmortem items faster. Sketch below — thoughts?
Maya: Love the ledger idea. Can we make ownership SLA 14 days by default? :thinking_face: 
Alex: Yes. Default SLA 14d for short remediations, 45d for project-grade items. Add a weekly 'remediation sync' to reduce drift.
Raj: Agree. Also suggest a 'recurrence_flag' if an incident repeats >2 times in 90d so we escalate to reliability review.
Jamie: Could we have an auto-generated table from Jira issues? Or just a CSV template teams can drop in. :+1: 
Alex: CSV example:
```
incident_id,remediation_owner,mitigation_owner,priority,sla,status,first_occurrence,recurrence_count,validation_criteria,notes
INC-2024-258,jamie,leo,high,14d,open,2024-12-18,0,smoke-test+metrics-check,DB failover flakiness
```
Leo: Comms cadence proposal: initial update within 24h, status update at 72h, then weekly until closed. IC rotation: 6-week rotation with 3-day overlap for handoffs.
Maya: Overlap is smart. Also we should separate 'mitigation_owner' (short-term) from 'remediation_owner' (long-term project) in the ledger.
Alex: Good call — add fields: mitigation_owner, remediation_owner, rollout_date, validation_criteria. Validation = synthetic smoke + production checks + user-impact monitor.
Raj: One more: add a 'regression_eval' checkpoint 7 days after close to catch recurring patterns and mark recurrence_count.
oncall-bot: Reminder — new ledger template will be added to /docs/incidents by EOD Monday. :robot_face:
Jamie: I'll pilot this with the DB team this week and produce a sample CSV + slack workflow for posting updates.
Alex: Thanks — assigning @jamie as pilot owner. I'll draft the template and open a PR for feedback. :wave:
Maya: SGTM :thumbsup:
